verdict.rationale: Canny's public portal and feedback capture features (canny-docs-1, canny-docs-7, canny-docs-8) imply a self-serve portal exists, but the evidence pack focuses on developer-facing integration steps (adding a link, installing a JS SDK) that assume engineering involvement rather than a no-code PM setup flow. missing for 10: explicit onboarding/admin docs showing a PM can configure branding, domains, and boards without a developer, and independent confirmation of a no-code setup wizard.
